_meta.description: Compose batch of two crosstab slots (control and variant arms of the experiment cohort) over region x segment decorated with an OVERLAY_Z_CELL matrix overlay that runs a per-cell two-sample z-test on the means against the matching control cell. Cell aggregator is AGG_WELFORD which emits the streaming Welford-Pebay triple {Mean, Variance, N} as the cell payload (RichAggregator interface). The OVERLAY_Z_CELL handler is triple-aware (E1-S17 / S18): when both target and reference cells carry a WelfordTriple the handler consumes the triple directly so variance and n are read from the streaming sample state instead of the Params defaults. Each cell's value becomes the two-sided z p-value as a float64. Reuses the standardNormalCDF helper backing TEST_Z_TWO_SAMPLE so the overlay p-value matches the row-test surface byte-for-byte for the same (mean, variance, n) inputs. Math: se = sqrt(var_target/n_target + var_ref/n_ref); z = (mean_target - mean_ref) / se; p = 2 * (1 - Phi(|z|)). Sibling kind to OVERLAY_T_CELL (Welch t) at the same MATRIX host shape - same Welch-style SE recurrence, different finalising distribution (standard normal vs Student's t). Degenerate inputs (n < 2, variance = 0, missing reference cell) produce NaN p-values with one PULSE_OVERLAY_REF_ZERO warning per affected cell. Inherently buffered - inferential overlays as a family stay buffered until a streamable-test path is plumbed (PRD Non-Goals).
_meta.name: pairwise-z-matrix
